source.title: Kloofendal 48d Partly Cloudy (Pure Sky)
source.modifications: Byte-identical original Radiance HDR retained and distributed. Photographic source, not AI-generated imagery. Visible sky samples this unmodified HDR with a level yaw and day fade.

runtimeDerivative.processing: Latitude-strip solid-angle 2x2 downsample; measured source solar core inside 2 degrees filled from weighted 4–8 degree sky annulus, smoothly blending until 4 degrees. Synthetic lower hemisphere blends to scene ground radiance over y=-0.16..0. Directional sun replaces the removed direct disc; bright surrounding clouds remain.
runtimeDerivative.qualityPolicy: All qualities keep the same 1024x512 visible texture and one face128 PMREM. Quality changes neither fetch/decode nor regenerate/upload new sky resources.

exclusions: this provenance file and THREE-LICENSE.txt are retained source documentation, not runtime texture copies
validationBoundary: Actual HDR bytes and CPU source/native Three control flow verified. No GPU shader compilation, gameplay image, FPS, device memory measurement or PS4 parity is established.
